name: minreport-core
description: MINREPORT: Sistema inteligente de control y reportabilidad para la pequeña minería (SaaS + Mobile + Módulos Integrados)

scripts.dev:server: NODE_ENV=development TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true MOCK_EMAILS=false FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8085 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9190 FIREBASE_STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9195 FIRESTORE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 nodemon --watch src src/index.ts
scripts.dev:server:test: NODE_ENV=test TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true MOCK_EMAILS=true FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8085 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9190 FIREBASE_STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9195 FIRESTORE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 nodemon --watch src src/index.ts
scripts.build:functions: npm install --prefix services/functions && npm run build --prefix services/functions
scripts.serve:emulators: unset _JAVA_OPTIONS && unset GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS && [ -d "/usr/local/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home" ] && export JAVA_HOME="/usr/local/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; npx firebase-tools emulators:start --only auth,firestore,storage --import=./data --export-on-exit=./data
scripts.serve:emulators:full: unset _JAVA_OPTIONS && unset GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS && [ -d "/usr/local/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home" ] && export JAVA_HOME="/usr/local/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; npx firebase-tools emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,hosting,storage --import=./data --export-on-exit=./data
scripts.backup:data: npm run export:emulators && git add data && git commit -m "Data Backup $(date)"
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently --kill-others --names "EMU,API,WEB" --prefix-colors "yellow,blue,green" "npm run serve:emulators" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
